name: Inami Akiho
source:
The owner of the apartment where Tooru lives. She is a celebrity MILF who lives with her son, Yuki, on the top floor of a luxurious apartment building.

She has a bright and mischievous personality and is gorgeous in appearance. She enjoys having sex with salesmen and poor students who can't afford to pay their rent.

She is the proud mother of Yuuki, and mother and son get along well. She loves Yuuki very much and wants to avoid him from finding out her true nature, even if it kills her.

She is proud of her big boobs, which are still firm beyond her age, but she is worried that they are beginning to give way to gravity.

[From [url=http://www.cattleyasoft.com/cat11/character.html]official site[/url]]
